units.source_text: 岁历云暮，朱雀院的病还是不见好转，因此诸事忙乱。

en.t: As the year drew to its close, Suzaku-in's illness still showed no sign of improving, and everything was in confusion.

units.source_text: 最是三公主着裳式的种种准备，喧哗扰攘，盛大无比，可谓空前绝后。

en.t: Above all, the many preparations for the Third Princess's coming-of-age ceremony were noisy, bustling, and magnificently grand, something that might be called without precedent or equal.

units.source_text: 仪式场设在朱雀院内皇后所居的柏殿中。

en.t: The ceremony was arranged in the Kashiwagi Hall, where the Empress resided within Suzaku-in's palace.

units.source_text: 自帐幕、帷屏以至一切设备，一概不用本国绫锦，全部仿照中国皇后宫殿的装饰，富丽堂皇，灿烂夺目。

en.t: From the curtains and screens to every furnishing, no domestic brocades were used; everything followed the style of a Chinese empress's palace, splendid, sumptuous, and dazzling to the eye.

units.source_text: 结腰之职，预先聘定太政大臣担任。

en.t: The role of tying the ceremonial sash had been arranged in advance for the Grand Minister of State.

units.source_text: 太政大臣为人十分认真，一向不肯轻易参谒朱雀院。

en.t: The Grand Minister was a very conscientious man and had never been willing to visit Suzaku-in casually.

units.source_text: 但他从来不曾违背朱雀院的意旨，故此次一口答应，如期到场。

en.t: Yet he had never gone against Suzaku-in's wishes, so this time he agreed at once and appeared on the appointed day.

units.source_text: 参与仪式的有左大臣、右大臣，以及其他诸王侯公卿。

en.t: Those taking part in the ceremony included the Minister of the Left, the Minister of the Right, and many other princes and high nobles.

units.source_text: 即使是有不得已之事而难以出席者，也勉力安排停当，前来助喜。

en.t: Even those who had unavoidable affairs and found it difficult to attend made every effort to put matters in order and come to add to the celebration.

units.source_text: 其中有亲王八人，殿上人自不必说，冷泉帝方面和皇太子方面的人，也都到齐。

en.t: Among them were eight imperial princes; the courtiers of the palace were there as a matter of course, and the people from Emperor Reizei's side and the Crown Prince's side were all present as well.

units.source_text: 仪式之庄严隆重，无以复加。

en.t: The ceremony could not have been more solemn or magnificent.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝与皇太子想起了这是朱雀院平生最后一次盛会，都替他惋惜，因此从藏人所和纳殿中取出许多唐朝舶来的宝物，作为献礼。

en.t: Emperor Reizei and the Crown Prince, thinking that this would be the last great celebration of Suzaku-in's life, both felt sorrow for him and brought out many treasures imported from Tang China from the Chamberlains' Office and the storehouse to offer as gifts.

units.source_text: 六条院送来的礼品也非常珍贵。

en.t: The gifts sent by Rokujo-in were also extremely precious.

units.source_text: 朱雀院回敬各方面的赠品、赐与出席诸人的福物，以及酬谢主宾太政大臣的礼品，都是由六条院代办的。

en.t: The return gifts from Suzaku-in to all sides, the good-fortune gifts bestowed on those in attendance, and the presents thanking the Grand Minister of State as guest of honor were all handled on his behalf by Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后也送服装和梳具箱，意匠都很优美。

en.t: Empress Akikonomu also sent garments and a comb box, all beautifully designed.

units.source_text: 其中有从前她入宫时朱雀院所赐的梳具箱，已经加工改造，形式更见美观，然而不失原来风格，一见即知是当年之物。

en.t: Among them was the comb box that Suzaku-in had given her long ago when she entered the palace; it had been reworked and made even more beautiful in form, yet it had not lost its original style, and one could tell at a glance that it was the same object from those days.

units.source_text: 这梳具箱于当日傍晚送到。

en.t: This comb box arrived that evening.

units.source_text: 使者是中宫职的权亮，又是朱雀院的殿上人。

en.t: The messenger was the Provisional Assistant Director of the Empress's Household Office, and also a courtier in attendance on Suzaku-in.

units.source_text: 他把礼物呈上，声言是赠与三公主的。

en.t: He presented the gifts and stated that they were for the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 其中附有赠朱雀院的诗：

en.t: Among them was attached a poem addressed to Suzaku-in:
